text:
mike: Quick weirdness in sample-starter: python/sdk-jsonmode rejects tool result with 'expected object, got string' while JS accepts. Both using same function spec.
olivia: Any chance the retry wrapper is returning an already-stringified payload? That would show up as a JSON string like "{}".
tarun: Yep saw that in logs: after auth refresh the payload looked like "{\"metadata\":{}}" (double-encoded). Python's parser treats that as a string and fails schema validation.
ci-bot: test run: added unit that simulates auth retry + double-encoded response, failing on py-sdk v1.4.1.
mike: Minimal repro in sample app: ```json
{"name":"index","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"metadata":{"type":"object","nullable":true}}}
``` observed outputs: ```json
{"metadata":"{}"}
{"metadata":{}}
```
olivia: Proposed fixes: 1) runtime: ensure auth-retry path returns raw parsed JSON to SDK, 2) SDKs: sanitizer should detect JSON-encoded strings and safely parse them in json-mode, 3) docs: note that double-encoding will break strict validators.
tarun: My vote: fix runtime first (source of truth), add sanitizer parsing as fallback in SDKs, and add cross-sdk fixtures to devex CI. Also add a small feature flag like jsonMode.lenientParsing for sample kits.
ops-bot: FYI deploy: auth-retry normalization patch landed to canary 2026-03-10 16:02 UTC.
mike: Temporary local workaround in starter: post-parse normalize: ```py
if isinstance(resp.get('metadata'), str):
    try:
        resp['metadata'] = json.loads(resp['metadata'])
    except Exception:
        pass
```
olivia: I'll open tickets: runtime#5120, sdk-js#780, sdk-py#622 and link repro. Adding a short note to the JSON-mode guide about retry double-encode.
tarun: I'll add cross-language tests and a tiny sample showing the normalization snippet.
mike: Thanks, team. This one was a nasty intermittent DX bug to surface in onboarding. :+1:
